title: ConditionalForwarder
description: Points to a remote domain with which you are setting up a trust relationship. Conditional forwarders are required in order to set up a trust relationship with another domain.

allOf.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the remote domains pointed to by the conditional forwarder.
The IP addresses of the remote DNS server associated with RemoteDomainName. This is the IP address of the DNS server that your conditional forwarder points to.

The replication scope of the conditional forwarder. The only allowed value is Domain, which will replicate the conditional forwarder to all of the domain controllers for your Amazon Web Services directory.
